name: Isabella
source:
The village chief of the village Ariana and Mira visited.

She is about 40 years old? (Mira's guess). Her favorite drink is milk tea. She was impressed by Mira and Ariana's skills when they visited her village, and asks them to retrieve a jewel for the festival that was stolen by thieves.

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/mahara_simai/sisters_top.html]official site[/url]]
